title: Network tools
description: Interfaces, public IP, ping, connectivity check and a speed test

actions.label: Internet check
actions.command: curl -o /dev/null -sS --max-time 10 -w '%{http_code} %{time_total} %{remote_ip}\n' https://www.gstatic.com/generate_204 | awk '{printf "HTTP %s in %.2f s via %s\n", $1, $2, $3}'

actions.label: Speed test (25 MB)
actions.command: curl -o /dev/null -sS --max-time 60 -w '%{speed_download} %{size_download} %{time_total}\n' 'https://speed.cloudflare.com/__down?bytes=25000000' | awk '{printf "Download %.1f Mbit/s (%.0f MB in %.1f s)\n", $1*8/1000000, $2/1000000, $3}'
